subject: Porsche
hook: PORSCHE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Porsche did not originally manufacture cars under its own name; the company started as a consulting firm that designed the Volkswagen Beetle.
angle_support: Initially, the company offered motor vehicle development work and consulting, but did not build any cars under its own name.
One of the first assignments the new company received was from the German government to design a car for the people; that is, a Volkswagen.
title: Porsche Began As A Beetle Designer, Not A Car Brand
description: Many think Porsche always built cars with its own badge, but the firm started as a consultancy. Its first big job was creating the Volkswagen Beetle, not a Porsche sports car.
narration: PORSCHE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You assume Porsche has always sold cars bearing its name, but originally it was a design consultancy that never produced a vehicle under the Porsche badge itself. Founded in 1931, Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche GmbH offered motor‑vehicle development and consulting only, building no cars under its own badge; its first major contract was the German government’s request to design the people’s car, which became the Volkswagen Beetle, and it launched the iconic design worldwide. It started engineering, not selling its own cars to the world.
